# Baseball-Reference.com

> The comprehensive statistical database for Major League Baseball, providing detailed player profiles, team histories, game scores, and historical records spanning all eras of professional baseball.

Baseball-Reference.com is the authoritative source for MLB statistics and historical data, covering current season information alongside historical records including Negro Leagues. The site features extensive player profiles with career statistics, performance metrics, and rookie season tracking across all positions and eras.

## Key Topics

- MLB (Major League Baseball)
- Player Statistics
- Career Statistics
- Batting Statistics
- Pitching Statistics
- WAR (Wins Above Replacement)
- Player Profiles
- Team Franchises
- American League
- National League
- Box Scores
- Performance Metrics
- Rookie of the Year
- ERA (Earned Run Average)
- Historical Records

## Scores & Standings

- [2025 MLB Scores, Standings, Box Scores](https://www.baseball-reference.com/boxes): Current season scores, standings, and detailed box scores

## Teams & Leagues

- [List of all the Major League Baseball Teams](https://www.baseball-reference.com/teams): Directory of all MLB teams with franchise history and statistics
- [History of All Major League Baseball: National League, American League, Negro League and more](https://www.baseball-reference.com/leagues): Historical overview of MLB leagues including Negro Leagues

## Star Player Profiles
